stem:
Kavya finds a laboratory thermometer. Its scale runs from −20 °C to 120 °C. Between the 40 °C and 50 °C marks there are 10 equal small divisions.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The value of the smallest division is 1 °C.
With 10 divisions between 40 °C and 50 °C, each division measures 10 °C.

teacher.key_rationale: Range is the lowest to highest marked temperature: −20 °C to 120 °C. Smallest division is (50 − 40) ÷ 10 = 1 °C, not 10 °C.
